bindings.claim: G7 actual original-family reset-policy finite horizon
bindings.hypotheses: Finite V,E,X,ID,Copy,Row,Obs,Out; Nonempty Copy; complete ID equivalence onto every actual original hybrid; one OriginalFamily point s supplies graph, strict calendar, original parents, inheritance, mode and positive rates. Programme randomization precedes biological randomness; reset calls use the SAME s. Source admission, target and allowed programme family supplied. Concrete row/site/call budget is deletion-closed. The total-policy premise is forall s, admitted s -> CorrectRun experiment policy s [] []; not merely termination on one source or a rival chosen afresh per row. Plan theorem additionally assumes Nonempty T.
bindings.conclusion: A pointwise-total correct original policy yields a valid identifying plan of depth card(Row × Obs); failure of this bounded game rules out every such policy at the same budget.
bindings.not_supplied: General effective cofacial/source admission, algebraic source coverage, QE/CAD selection, native policy AST or portable Rust refinement.

bindings.claim: G1 original-class common core and all-n sharpness
bindings.hypotheses: Finite original Source X, original parent registry, card X >=4 and HasGalledOuterSemidirectedPartner. This is the finite binary LSA/CutChild outer-labelled galled semidirected parallel-arc domain encoded by the original structures, not arbitrary networks. All finite copy allocations, original registers, positive rates, interior inheritance and complete histories are quantified.
bindings.conclusion: One source-derived reduced decorated core preserves the stated literal and physical targets, current-root interface, original root blob and complete unranked history; h<=2n-2,V<=6n-5,E<=8n-8. Every n>=4 has an actual admitted positive/interior source attaining all three bounds.
bindings.not_supplied: A bound on serial-word length, G3 inverse witness size, ranked merger-time experiment equivalence, or arbitrary-network normalization.

theorem actual_G1_original_class_master_with_all_n_sharpness :
    (∀ (O : Source.{u,v,w} X) (H : OriginalParentRegistry O.network)

    ∃ (T : Source X) (D : Decoration O T) (hD : Originated O H D),
      HasGalledOuterSemidirectedPartner T ∧ Steps O T ∧ Reduced T ∧ (hybrids T.network).card ≤ 2 * Fintype.card X - 2 ∧
      Fintype.card T.Vertex ≤ 6 * Fintype.card X - 5 ∧ Fintype.card T.Edge ≤ 8 * Fintype.card X - 8 ∧
      SameLiteralSemidirectedTargets O T ∧ SamePhysicalTargets O T ∧ UniformCurrentRootInterface O T D ∧
      (∀ f : O.Edge, O.network.graph.SameBlob O.network.root (O.network.graph.source f) →
        O.network.graph.SameBlob O.network.root (O.network.graph.target f) → ∃ e : T.Edge, D.recipe e = .raw f) ∧
      (∀ (Copy : Type c) [Fintype Copy] [DecidableEq Copy]

        SameCompletedOriginalHistory O H D hD sample register (naturalInteriorGamma O.network p) common r history ∧

    (∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n),
    ∃ S : Source.{0,0,0} (Fin n), Reduced S ∧ HasGalledOuterSemidirectedPartner S ∧

bindings.claim: G2 actual natural/controlled complete timed all-panel projectivity
bindings.hypotheses: Finite original RootedBinary N, Calendar N.graph, copy allocation, original parent registry, positive pair rates. Natural instance uses HybridProbabilities and originalRegisterPMF; controlled instance uses one OriginalMask and the same original-register bank. The generic registered theorem accepts a PMF over once-drawn registers. Includes empty/singleton keep panels.
bindings.conclusion: Literal pruning of the complete registered timed observation law equals the smaller-panel law, with pair ages and completed unranked forest carried together.
bindings.not_supplied: Arbitrary stopping-time interventions, sequence calibration, a native implementation or a stronger equality of unobserved trajectory paths.
exact_source_signatures:
theorem actual_registered_timed_all_panel_projectivity (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (sample : Copy → X) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (gamma : Hybrid N → unitInterval) (common : Hybrid N → Bool) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (ρ : PMF (V → Bool)) (keep : Finset Copy) :
    ((registeredTraceLaw N sample r (compiledCalendarProgram N C H gamma common) ρ).map
      (fullReadout N C sample Finset.univ (compiledCalendarProgram N C H gamma common))).map (pruneRegistered keep) =
    (registeredTraceLaw N (selectedSample sample keep) r (compiledCalendarProgram N C H gamma common) ρ).map
      (smallReadout N C sample keep (compiledCalendarProgram N C H gamma common))

theorem actual_natural_complete_timed_all_panel_projectivity (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (sample : Copy → X) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (p : HybridProbabilities N) (common : Hybrid N → Bool) (r : PositivePairRates E) (keep : Finset Copy) :
    ((originalTimedTraceLaw N C sample H p common r).map
      (fullReadout N C sample Finset.univ (compiledCalendarProgram N C H (originalGamma p) common))).map (pruneRegistered keep) =
    (originalTimedTraceLaw N C (selectedSample sample keep) H p common r).map
      (smallReadout N C sample keep (compiledCalendarProgram N C H (originalGamma p) common))

theorem actual_controlled_complete_timed_all_panel_projectivity (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (C : GProgram.G5.Calendar N.graph) (sample : Copy → X) (H : OriginalParentRegistry N)
    (p : HybridProbabilities N) (common : Hybrid N → Bool) (r : PositivePairRates E)
    (mask : OriginalMask N) (keep : Finset Copy) :
    ((controlledTimedTraceLaw N C sample H p common r mask).map
      (fullReadout N C sample Finset.univ (controlledCalendarProgram N C H p common mask))).map (pruneRegistered keep) =
    (controlledTimedTraceLaw N C (selectedSample sample keep) H p common r mask).map
      (smallReadout N C sample keep (controlledCalendarProgram N C H p common mask))

bindings.claim: G6 exact rational affine witness solver
bindings.hypotheses: A supplied finite rational system of strict/weak affine rows, dimension n. Ordered list interface permits duplicate rows and is proved equal to the finite-set solver's returned vector.
bindings.conclusion: Total executable rational witness-returning solver is sound and complete for REAL affine feasibility; none iff infeasible. Positive certificates have an executable checker.
bindings.not_supplied: An original graph/chart generator, nonlinear law constraints, unknown-size graph census, native-language equivalence or whole G6 cloud/target-image compiler.
exact_source_signatures:
theorem checkRationalWitness_correct {n : ℕ} (R : Finset (Row n)) (q : Fin n → ℚ) :
    checkRationalWitness R q = true ↔ ∀ r ∈ R, r.Holds q

theorem solveRational_sound {n : ℕ} (R : Finset (Row n)) (q : Fin n → ℚ)
    (h : solveRational n R = some q) : ∀ r ∈ R, r.Holds q

theorem solveRational_complete (n : ℕ) (R : Finset (Row n)) :
    (∃ q, solveRational n R = some q) ↔ Feasible ℝ R

theorem solveRational_none_iff (n : ℕ) (R : Finset (Row n)) :
    solveRational n R = none ↔ ¬ Feasible ℝ R

theorem solveList_eq_solveRational (n : ℕ) (R : List (Row n)) :
    solveList n R = solveRational n R.toFinset

bindings.claim: G6 one shared physical bank from a supplied original-source cell
bindings.hypotheses: Supplied finite original RootedBinary N, finite chronology/exposure/coin chart and bijective layout BankVar N equiv Fin n. All chart constraints share one rational age/inverse-rate/coin vector.
bindings.conclusion: Solver success iff originalCellFeasible; returned vector decodes to one strict Calendar, positive pair rates and interior inheritance bank meeting all supplied rows. Certified solver retains exactly the same vector.
bindings.not_supplied: Automatic original-source/chart generation or nonlinear exact observation-law constraints. Real-carrier physical bank realization is noncomputable although rational solver/checker are executable.
exact_source_signatures:
theorem solveOriginalCell_sound (chronology : C → AgeConstraint V)
    (rows : I → Exposure V E) (coins : Hybrid N → RationalInterval) (q : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hq : solveOriginalCell N layout chronology rows coins = some q) :
    BankConditions N chronology rows coins
      (agesOf N layout (fun i => (q i : ℝ)))
      (inverseRatesOf N layout (fun i => (q i : ℝ)))
      (coinsOf N layout (fun i => (q i : ℝ)))

theorem solveOriginalCell_complete (chronology : C → AgeConstraint V)
    (rows : I → Exposure V E) (coins : Hybrid N → RationalInterval) :
    (∃ q, solveOriginalCell N layout chronology rows coins = some q) ↔
      originalCellFeasible N chronology rows coins

theorem solveOriginalCell_none_iff (chronology : C → AgeConstraint V)
    (rows : I → Exposure V E) (coins : Hybrid N → RationalInterval) :
    solveOriginalCell N layout chronology rows coins = none ↔
      ¬ originalCellFeasible N chronology rows coins

theorem solveOriginalCellCertified_values (chronology : C → AgeConstraint V)
    (rows : I → Exposure V E) (coins : Hybrid N → RationalInterval) :
    (solveOriginalCellCertified N layout chronology rows coins).map Subtype.val =
      solveOriginalCell N layout chronology rows coins

theorem checkedOriginalCellBank_feasible (chronology : C → AgeConstraint V)
    (rows : I → Exposure V E) (coins : Hybrid N → RationalInterval) (q : Fin n → ℚ)
    (hq : checkOriginalCellWitness N layout chronology rows coins q = true) :
    originalCellFeasible N chronology rows coins

bindings.conclusion: One original rate/inheritance bank realizes z,g before the comparison calendar and ALL original control masks; natural and all controlled completed laws agree for any other original calendar/rate bank with the same survival vector.

    (z : E → ℝ) (g : Hybrid N → ℝ)

hypotheses.FinitePositiveLaw: A finite set of distinct real nodes; every member strictly positive; each on-set weight strictly positive; total weighted mass exactly1. Weight values outside the finite set are immaterial.
hypotheses.moment: moment(mu,k) = sum over x in mu.nodes of mu.weight(x) * x^k.
hypotheses.domain: The whole strictly positive real axis. No upper bound below1 is assumed; physical survival admission is a separate receiver.
